name: Ehrenbachhöhe
beschreibung: The Hotel Ehrenbachhöhe is situated on a sunny high plateau above Going, with direct views of the rocky cliffs of the Wilder Kaiser. In summer, the surroundings are characterized by a dense network of hiking trails, and in winter by direct access to the SkiWelt ski area. The atmosphere of the house is quiet and traditional, with Alpine-style interiors defining the guest areas. A small wellness area with sauna is available for relaxation, and the restaurant focuses on regional products. The accommodation is aimed at hikers, skiers, and guests who appreciate an unpretentious place to stay in an exposed high-altitude location. The panoramic view from the terrace and the rooms is a key feature of the house.
